summary: Optional keys: chatbot_agent_config_extras (for example chatbot_temperature_override) and, for MCP, aap_gateway_url (http://<cr>) to provision the Lightspeed Service MCP server, plus aap_controller_url (http://<cr>-controller-service) to add the controller MCP server; both use the user's JWT.
questions: How do I enable the MCP server for the intelligent assistant?
What is aap_controller_url in the chatbot secret?
